material_findings.finding: The F1 BJT path sets CJC equal to the cited biased Cobo, sets CJE to Cibo minus Cobo, and sets TF to 1/(2*pi*fT). The existing BJT archetype voltage-de-embeds Cobo and Cibo to zero-bias junction capacitances and subtracts capacitance and series-resistance delay from the published total fT delay before assigning TF.

Condition-specific hFE minima and maxima are collapsed into one global minimum and maximum and compared as if they shared collector current and VCE. This can reject electrically valid current-dependent tables as inconsistent and can cap BF using a maximum from a different bias point.
material_findings.sample: D882 was reported as inconsistent because a 200 minimum and 120 maximum were compared globally after source conditions were discarded from the aggregation.

material_findings.finding: VCE(sat) and VBE(sat) limit rows are converted directly into final RC, RE, and RB values. The existing archetype uses the same style of calculation only as an optimizer seed, then performs native-ngspice fitting. Treating independent maximum limits as observed slope points is not an equivalent evidence-backed derivation.

Regression assertions lock in the direct TF, CJC, and CJE formulas and mock the ngspice runner, so the tests pass while the generated AC parameters miss the existing archetype contract and source benches.
